thread:
Lena (AE): OptiMed wants a 6-week POC. Key asks: strict EU-only processing for PHI, subprocessors list filtered to EU, BYOK with HSM, and a single-line delta for a small reserved pool. Can legal/ops advise?
Ravi (SE): quick clarifier 1do they accept global control-plane for auth/routing (no user content) or require full in-region control-plane?
Jon (OptiMed): control-plane metadata outside EU is acceptable as long as no user content or logs leave EU. Prefer eu-central-1. Need procurement-friendly checklist + cost delta.
Marta (Legal): we can produce subprocessors CSV + SOC2/ISO PDFs. If they require control-plane residency, escalate to Private (different pricing/timeline). I'll flag subprocessors that run EU infra.
Kai (Infra Ops): hosted = geo-affinity, not a hard lock. Dedicated supports tenant pinning to eu-central-1 with data-plane, KV cache, and storage kept in-region. BYOK + HSM provisioning ETA ~2 weeks.
Ravi (SE): example dev endpoint for them to test:
```
POST https://api.redwood-inference.eu/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{ "model": "rwd-alpha-1", "input": "..." }
```
Control plane (global metadata): https://control.redwood-inference.com/signals (no user payload).
Lena (AE): procurement will need a headline number. Ravi, ballpark delta for single-region small reserved pool (~60 sustained QPS)?
Ravi (SE): ballpark: +$10k-13k/mo above hosted for single-region small reserved (4x A100 equiv). Dual-region/resident control-plane or Private significantly higher. Quantization + batching may reduce effective costs ~20-30%. Will confirm formal quote.
Marta (Legal): I'll prepare the DPA + subprocessors sheet with EU flags and a short addendum template for procurement.
Kai (Infra Ops): ops checklist for OptiMed to provide:
- Preferred EU region (eu-central-1)
- Sustained QPS + peak
- BYOK: public key, KMS contact, rotation cadence
- IP ranges for allowlist (if needed)
- Required certs/attestations (SOC2/ISO/etc.)
- POC start window and rollback plan
maint-bot: scheduled maintenance notice - eu-central-1 network upgrade 2025-09-10 03:00-03:30 UTC; no data-plane downtime expected.
Jon (OptiMed): great, send subprocessors CSV + one-pager for BYOK steps and timeline. Procurement will review.
Lena (AE): thanks team 1Marta/Kai please drop the docs and I'll package for OptiMed.
